synthesizedFacts.fact: Perioral dermatitis is a skin disorder characterized by a red rash around the mouth, which can also spread to the nose and eyes.
The exact cause of perioral dermatitis is unknown, but it is often associated with topical steroid use, fluoride toothpaste, and certain cosmetics.
Perioral dermatitis is more common in women aged 25-45 and can be mistaken for acne or rosacea.
Treatment often involves discontinuing topical steroids and may include topical or oral antibiotics.
